title: Fix canvas background mode not clearing correctly in Compatibility renderer

labels.name: cherrypick:4.3
labels.description: Considered for cherry-picking into a future 4.3.x release

body:
There was an inconsistency in framebuffer clear behaviour between Compatibility and the other renderers when using the 'Canvas' background mode.

More specifically, when using an intermediate framebuffer in the GLES3 backend (eg. when `Glow` post-processing effect was enabled), the framebuffer was not being cleared before having the current `rt` copied over, resulting in a feedback loop equivalent to setting `Environment::background` to `RS::ENV_BG_KEEP`.

In the other backends this doesn't appear to be the case, so I have modified the GLES3 backend to clear the framebuffer before copying when `Environment::background` is set to `RS::ENV_BG_CANVAS`.

| Background Mode | Compatibility | Compatibility (w/ Glow) | Forward+ |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Clear Color | ![compat_color](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4e5f9c7c-5d3e-4031-b0b3-0bf46024dfd5) | ![compat_glow_color](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/17f200b9-148b-4d58-a571-7202a2405f34) | ![forward_color](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/49f6323c-47c7-411f-b3ab-82ed2cc01414) |
| Sky | ![compat_sky](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1f9e4e84-2172-4f6b-8868-b683f39ade74) | ![compat_glow_sky](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5818dade-0d47-49a3-9cf7-4f9327ba6a63) | ![forward_sky](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7690de5a-2894-4eb7-a6ca-e963db7615ad) |
| Canvas | ![compat_canvas](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/16a1da07-be6a-464d-ab22-6cbf945adbae) | ![compat_glow_canvas](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b6cc7a59-0214-45fc-b76f-b093f0c563bc) | ![forward_canvas](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c9f40b7d-0b52-4723-9439-6b90ae72097a) |
| Keep | ![compat_keep](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f607fbec-3830-4033-b822-20d1a417c30b) | ![compat_glow_keep](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f0a443d-cb3e-41c4-9712-b7f078de94b0) | ![forward_keep](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9307cf29-115a-49c8-b70d-46d5a3233d80) |
| Camera Feed | ![compat_feed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dd17ab24-fcdf-4fb4-878e-6213650c6d50) | ![compat_glow_feed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f34f1a61-efc4-4948-8e0c-e84ccc37984f) | ![forward_feed](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/39670017-67a1-4364-90b5-7d2fb26474d9) |

[Looks like the other backends have had issues with this in the past too](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/68805), but would certainly like some extra testing on this as I am not too familiar with this setup.

Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/100203
